description: This file declares the NtlmClient class which implements NTLMv1 and NTLMv2 authentication protocols, supporting features like MIC and EPA, and provides methods to generate NTLM negotiate and authenticate messages.

classes.name: NtlmClient
classes.description: Implements NTLMv1 and NTLMv2 client with support for MIC and EPA, capable of generating negotiate and authenticate messages.

methods.name: GenerateAuthenticateMessage
methods.description: Generates the NTLM authenticate message with detailed parameters including domain, username, password, hostname, channel bindings, spn, client time, and challenge messages.

methods.name: GenerateAuthenticateMessageV1
methods.description: Simplified NTLMv1 authenticate message generator without channel bindings, spn, or client time.
